About Me

My name is Neil Jones, and I am 73 years old, living in Gloucestershire, England. I have always enjoyed taking photographs of family and friends, capturing special moments over the years. However, it was only after retiring that photography truly became a meaningful and dedicated hobby for me. With more time on my hands, I’ve been able to focus more seriously on developing my skills and exploring the art of photography.

I often take photographs locally around Gloucestershire and throughout the surrounding natural landscape. I’m especially drawn to the countryside and the changing seasons. One of the most fulfilling parts of my hobby is printing my photographs and hanging them on the walls of our home, where they serve as lasting reminders of the places and moments I’ve enjoyed capturing. I also have a huge passion for taking my photos in black and white.
